what_improved: ベル / 舌のないベル moved from concept-like fallback handling into first-class objects.
objects include object_subkind and retention_reason, making durable artifacts reviewable downstream.
relations use relation_category, relation_label, relation_summary, and evidence instead of relying on a narrow relation_type enum.
events include event_importance and retain dense prologue events without a hard three-event cap.
私 remains pronoun_like with needs_review and local_candidate review behavior.
赤子 remains descriptor/local candidate with needs_review rather than canon-final identity.
Useful baseline coverage is preserved for Adelman, Thiseia, 杖の一族, 王と杖 / 王者の杖, 均衡, ベル, 赤子, collapse, rescue, erasure, and regency transition.
Author/review usefulness improved through labels such as rescues_and_raises, keeps_artifact, maintains_balance_together, and takes_regency.
what_stayed_same: CANONICAL_ENTITY_MAP remains empty in capture context, so canonical identity approval is still out of scope.
Some title/descriptor entities such as 王, 王妃, 杖, 後継者 still require review because chapter evidence lacks stable names.
The sample remains a manual ChatGPT response, not provider runtime output or canon approval.
remaining_prompt_schema_issues: empty_canonical_entity_map_in_capture remains open for real e2e because fake-provider capture has no populated canonical map.
Global normalization with a populated map has not been re-audited after SP051.
Only one Japanese chapter has been compared post-hardening.
Spanish post-hardening behavior has not been tested.
Chunking/reduction path has not been audited.
Object materialization/rendering in downstream review surfaces may need deeper audit.
downstream_risks: Downstream consumers may need explicit object rendering and review queue support to benefit from objects.
Free relation_label values may add noise if UI/review tooling treats them as canonical taxonomy.
review_state/canonical_candidate semantics still require populated-map audit before auto-promotion is considered.
Large dense chapters may produce bigger outputs under event_importance policy.
recommended_next_phase: Phase 1.3.M-b5c canonical-map populated audit before chunking, then multi-chapter/chunking audit after extraction contract stays stable.
